Title: Could not create 'Nonce' for Bigone jwt
Description: ### ؜

Hi there,

I'm trying to read the balance from my Bigone account using a python script.
Beside the API_Key and Secret, there is also an JWT I need. But when I create the jwt, I always get an error:

ccxt.base.errors.AuthenticationError: bigone {"code":40004,"message":"nonce expired"} 

I have try everything, but get still the same error. Here is my code:

`
bigoneApi = os.environ.get('BIGONE_API_KEY')
bigoneSecret = os.environ.get('BIGONE_SECRET')

issuedAt = int(time.time())
expiration = int(time.time()) + 432000 # JWT will expire in 5 days
nonce = int(time.time() * 1000)

payload = {
    "type": "OpenAPI",
    "sub": bigoneApi,
    "iat": issuedAt,
    "exp": expiration,
    "nonce": nonce
}

bigoneToken = jwt.encode(payload, bigoneSecret, algorithm='HS256')
bigoneEx = ccxt.bigone({
    'apiKey': bigoneApi,
    'secret': bigoneSecret,
    'headers': {
        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + bigoneToken
    }
})`
